tickets.title: Write the one-page style guide
tickets.description: Palette per axiom, material value ranges, world scale rules, snap grid, silhouette requirements, fog and grade defaults. Week one — drift is invisible month to month and fatal over years.

tickets.title: Runtime Virtual Texture blending for props and buildings
tickets.description: Highest-value unification item. Objects visibly sitting on top of terrain is the number-one tell of procedural placement.

tickets.title: Clamp roughness and specular ranges across all assets
tickets.description: Mixed-source assets look wrong because their PBR values disagree, not because of texture quality.

tickets.title: Per-axiom global colour grades and LUTs
tickets.description: Deukalion's Flood, Demeter's Grief, Silence of the Oracles, the Unbinding, Artemis Withdrew, the Age of Kronos. The biggest perceptual win available.

tickets.title: Volumetric and height fog tuned per biome
tickets.description: Distance haze hides quality falloff, makes vistas read, and does most of the emotional work outdoors.

tickets.title: Single parameterised sun/sky system
tickets.description: Per biome and time of day. Never per asset, never hand-tuned per region.

tickets.title: PCG weathering and decal pass
tickets.description: Grime, moss and damage scattered uniformly. Disguises kit seams and makes assembled architecture look weathered rather than snapped together.

tickets.title: Silhouette review process for hero assets
tickets.description: Look at every one as a pure black silhouette. Five seconds each; catches nearly everything.

tickets.title: Author landmark silhouettes
tickets.description: Readable at a kilometre. The backbone of no-waypoint navigation.

tickets.title: Covered-face character system
tickets.description: Corinthian helmets, which cover the entire face by design, plus hoods, masks and weather gear. Removes facial rigging, animation, lipsync and uncanny valley from the critical path. Exposed faces reserved for Principals.

tickets.title: Faction material parameter sets
tickets.description: Colour, silhouette motif and material treatment on shared meshes.

tickets.title: Per-Law VFX identity
tickets.description: Hot metal, visceral red, burning script, ground-anchored light, guttering failure, shadow and tally marks.

tickets.title: Author axiom-specific hero assets
tickets.description: The things players look at closely and remember. Buy what they walk past.

tickets.title: Source and standardise the nature asset library
tickets.description: Megascans/Fab. Internally consistent and enormous — the reason the photoreal base is a budget-driven call.

tickets.title: Source architecture kits and animation sets
tickets.description: Buy rather than build. Animation is where small teams reliably lose.
